The '''Dread Guard Commander''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Dread Commander of the [[Dread Host]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was the in charge of a Dread Host's legion that tried to acquire the [[Aurora Cannon]] in the [[Section X]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] but a spacer defeated the Dread Guard Commander and his soldiers.

==Behind the scenes==
the Dread Guard Commander was the first member of the Dread host to appear in the game as boss in the Section X update.
